summary: A ~237,000 sq ft, five-story neuroscience research building at 675 Nelson Rising Lane housing roughly 100 principal investigators and 500+ researchers and staff, which opened May 2012.

milestones.text: Construction begins on Sandler Neurosciences Center

facts.value: Skidmore, Owings & Merrill (SOM), San Francisco office
~100 principal investigators (including a Nobel laureate) and 500+ researchers/staff

images.credit: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Farm Service Agency, NAIP aerial imagery (2024 flight), via USDA's 'latest NAIP' image service

images.caption: USDA NAIP aerial orthophoto (2024 flight), cropped to the Mission Bay project area and its immediate surroundings

sources.title: UC San Francisco Opens Sandler Neurosciences Center

open_questions: This record corrects this project's own earlier working assumption of a 2011 opening; May 2012 is well-supported by both the architect's own page and trade press.
No openly licensed image was found; none is hosted here.

Images: no plan drawing, elevation or openly-licensed photograph was found for this building specifically. Searched: UCSF Real Estate's Mission Bay campus-site and LRDP pages (realestate.ucsf.edu, blocked to automated fetches with a 403); the UCSF 2014 LRDP EIR's CEQAnet filing (SCH 2013092047, whose pre-2016 attachments aren't hosted on CEQAnet itself); a May 2000 Regents Committee on Grounds and Buildings design-approval item for an early Mission Bay building (text-only, no figures); the 2008 "UCSF Mission Bay Planning Principles" appendix (a citywide-scale community map, no individual buildings labeled); and a UCSF wayfinding campus map (not an adopted plan, EIR or permit filing, so not eligible as public-record even though found). Not pursued further in this pass; the record's own project sources above remain the citation for the building's history.
